<title>Tattooing Erkelenz — Book Consultation</title>
<style>
/* ── base reset ── */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --g:#c8a96e;--g2:#e8d5a8;--g3:rgba(200,169,110,.1);
  --bg:#0c0c0c;--s1:#141210;--s2:#1c1916;
  --bdr:rgba(200,169,110,.2);--bdr2:rgba(200,169,110,.45);
  --inp:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--tx:#ede8e0;--txm:rgba(237,232,224,.5);
  --txd:rgba(237,232,224,.28);--red:#e24b4a;--grn:#4a8c2a;
  --hov:#e8c97a;   /* warm amber gold — positive, readable, on-brand */
  --hov2:#f5dfa0;  /* lighter gold highlight for text on hover */
  --ct:#c8a96e;--cp:#5ec4e8;--cm:#d47fbf;
}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;min-height:100vh}
.tmf{max-width:740px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 0 5rem}
.tmf-hdr{padding:1.5rem 1.25rem 1.1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.brand-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.9rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--g);line-height:1}
.brand-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--txm);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
.hdr-r{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txm);text-align:right;line-height:1.7}
.prog-wrap{padding:0 1.25rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.prog-bars{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:7px}
.pb{flex:1;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--s2);transition:background .35s}
.pb.done,.pb.act{background:var(--g)}.pb.act{opacity:.55}
.prog-txt{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px}
.prog-step{color:var(--g);font-weight:500}.prog-name{color:var(--txm)}
.autosave-bar{font-size:10px;color:var(--txm);text-align:right;padding:0 1.25rem 6px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:5px}
.autosave-bar .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grn);display:inline-block}
.sec{padding:0 1.25rem}
.step{display:none}.step.active{display:block}
.mode-tabs{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.mode-tab{flex:1;padding:.65rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--txm);transition:all .2s;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.mode-tab:hover{color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.06)}.mode-tab.on{background:var(--g);color:#111;font-weight:600}
.mode-tab:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.card{background:var(--s1);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:12px;padding:1.25rem;margin-bottom:.85rem;transition:border-color .2s}
.card:focus-within{border-color:var(--bdr2)}
.card:hover{border-color:rgba(232,201,122,.3)}
.card-hd{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--g);margin-bottom:.8rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-hd.ct{color:var(--ct)}.card-hd.cp{color:var(--cp)}.card-hd.cm{color:var(--cm)}
.badge{font-size:8.5px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.badge-r{background:rgba(226,75,74,.12);border:1px solid rgba(226,75,74,.28);color:var(--red)}
.badge-o{background:rgba(200,169,110,.1);border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--g)}
.badge-g{background:rgba(74,140,42,.1);border:1px solid rgba(74,140,42,.3);color:#7dc46a}
.f{margin-bottom:.8rem}
.f label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--txm);margin-bottom:5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.rstar{color:var(--red);margin-left:2px}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{width:100%;background:var(--inp);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:7px;padding:10px 12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--tx);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;min-height:42px}
.f input:focus,.f select:focus,.f textarea:focus{border-color:var(--g);background:rgba(200,169,110,.03)}
.f input:hover,.f select:hover{border-color:rgba(232,201,122,.45)}
.f input::placeholder,.f textarea::placeholder{color:var(--txd)}
.f select option{background:#1a1713;color:var(--tx)}
.f textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:70px;line-height:1.6}
.f input.inv,.f select.inv,.f textarea.inv{border-color:var(--red)!important}
.f input.ok{border-color:var(--grn)!important}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.errmsg{font-size:11px;color:var(--red);margin-top:4px;display:none}
.errmsg.show{display:block}
.okmsg{font-size:11px;color:var(--grn);margin-top:3px;display:none}
.okmsg.show{display:block}
.hint{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:10px}
/* country + zip row */
.zip-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 1fr;gap:10px}
/* service cards */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:1rem}
.svc-card{border:1.5px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:10px;padding:1rem .75rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;background:var(--s1);transition:all .22s;position:relative}
.svc-card:hover{border-color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.04)}
.svc-card .ico{font-size:1.6rem;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.svc-card .sn{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.1em;display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.svc-card .ss{font-size:10px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.4}
.svc-card .ck{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#111}
.svc-card.sel-t{border-color:var(--ct);background:rgba(200,169,110,.07)}.svc-card.sel-t .sn{color:var(--ct)}.svc-card.sel-t .ck{background:var(--ct);display:flex}
.svc-card.sel-p{border-color:var(--cp);background:rgba(94,196,232,.06)}.svc-card.sel-p .sn{color:var(--cp)}.svc-card.sel-p .ck{background:var(--cp);display:flex}
.svc-card.sel-m{border-color:var(--cm);background:rgba(212,127,191,.06)}.svc-card.sel-m .sn{color:var(--cm)}.svc-card.sel-m .ck{background:var(--cm);display:flex}
/* chips */
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:5px}
.chip{padding:7px 14px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:20px;background:transparent;color:var(--txm);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--hov);color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.06)}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--g);background:var(--g3);color:var(--g);font-weight:500}
.chip.on-p{border-color:var(--cp);background:rgba(94,196,232,.1);color:var(--cp);font-weight:500}
.chip.on-m{border-color:var(--cm);background:rgba(212,127,191,.1);color:var(--cm);font-weight:500}
.chip .ck2{font-size:10px;display:none}
.chip.on .ck2,.chip.on-p .ck2,.chip.on-m .ck2{display:inline}
.cat-hd{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--txm);text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 6px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}
/* style categories */
.scat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.scat-btn{border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;padding:.6rem .4rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;background:var(--s2);transition:all .2s}
.scat-btn:hover{border-color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.05)}
.scat-btn.act{border-color:var(--g);background:var(--g3)}
.scat-btn .si{font-size:1.1rem;display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.scat-btn .sl{font-size:10px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.3}
.scat-btn.act .sl{color:var(--g)}
.style-panel{display:none;animation:fade .18s ease}
.style-panel.show{display:block}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-3px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.reveal{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .28s ease,opacity .2s;opacity:0}
.reveal.open{max-height:90px;opacity:1;margin-top:8px}
.reveal input{width:100%;background:var(--inp);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--tx);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s}
.reveal input:focus{border-color:var(--g)}
/* SVG zones */
.diag-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:10px}
.diag-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.diag-lbl{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--txm);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px}
.svg-diagram{width:100%;max-width:155px;overflow:visible}
.bz{fill:rgba(200,169,110,.1);stroke:rgba(200,169,110,.45);stroke-width:1;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .18s,stroke .18s,stroke-width .18s}
.bz:hover{fill:rgba(232,201,122,.22);stroke:var(--hov);stroke-width:1.4}
.bz.sel-t{fill:rgba(200,169,110,.32);stroke:#c8a96e;stroke-width:1.7}
.pz{fill:rgba(94,196,232,.1);stroke:rgba(94,196,232,.4);stroke-width:1;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s}
.pz:hover{fill:rgba(232,201,122,.18);stroke:var(--hov);stroke-width:1.4}
.pz.sel-p{fill:rgba(94,196,232,.32);stroke:#5ec4e8;stroke-width:1.7}
.mz{fill:rgba(212,127,191,.1);stroke:rgba(212,127,191,.4);stroke-width:1;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s}
.mz:hover{fill:rgba(232,201,122,.18);stroke:var(--hov);stroke-width:1.4}
.mz.sel-m{fill:rgba(212,127,191,.32);stroke:#d47fbf;stroke-width:1.7}
.bl{font-size:5.5px;fill:rgba(237,232,224,.7);text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.bl.sel-t{fill:#c8a96e;font-weight:700}
.bl.sel-p{fill:#5ec4e8;font-weight:700}
.bl.sel-m{fill:#d47fbf;font-weight:700}
.sk{fill:none;stroke:rgba(200,169,110,.12);stroke-width:.5;pointer-events:none}
.ml{fill:none;stroke:rgba(200,169,110,.1);stroke-width:.4;pointer-events:none}
/* placement tags */
.place-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:8px;min-height:20px}
.ptag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s}
.ptag:hover{opacity:.6}
.ptag-t{border-color:rgba(200,169,110,.5);color:var(--g);background:var(--g3)}
.ptag-p{border-color:rgba(94,196,232,.5);color:var(--cp);background:rgba(94,196,232,.08)}
.ptag-m{border-color:rgba(212,127,191,.5);color:var(--cm);background:rgba(212,127,191,.08)}
.place-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--txd);font-style:italic}
.tap-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--txm);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.tap-hint::before{content:'👆';font-size:12px}
/* ink allergy fields — kept for skin notes, but number picker removed */
/* upload */
.upzone{border:1.5px dashed rgba(200,169,110,.25);border-radius:10px;padding:1.25rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.upzone:hover{border-color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.04)}
.upzone.has{border-color:var(--grn);border-style:solid;background:rgba(74,140,42,.05)}
.up-ico{font-size:1.4rem;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;opacity:.5}
.up-lbl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--txm)}
.up-sub{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txd);margin-top:2px}
.up-name{font-size:12px;color:#7dc46a;margin-top:5px;display:none;font-weight:500}
.up-img{max-width:100%;max-height:120px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:10px;object-fit:contain;display:none}
.pdf-pill{display:none;margin-top:10px;padding:8px 14px;background:rgba(74,140,42,.1);border:1px solid rgba(74,140,42,.3);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#7dc46a;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pdf-pill.show{display:flex}
/* slots */
.slot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.slotbtn{padding:9px 4px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:7px;background:var(--s2);color:var(--txm);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .18s;font-weight:500}
.slotbtn:hover{border-color:var(--hov);color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.05)}
.slotbtn.on{border-color:var(--g);background:var(--g3);color:var(--g)}
/* consult */
.consult-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.cbtn{border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;padding:.75rem .5rem;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;background:var(--s2);transition:all .2s}
.cbtn:hover{border-color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.05)}
.cbtn .ci{font-size:1.2rem;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.cbtn .cl{font-size:12px;color:var(--txm)}
.cbtn.on{border-color:var(--g);background:var(--g3)}
.cbtn.on .cl{color:var(--g);font-weight:500}
/* health checkboxes */
.hcheck-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.hcheck{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;background:var(--s2)}
.hcheck:hover{border-color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.04)}
.hcheck input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--g);width:14px;height:14px;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}
.hcheck label{font-size:12px;color:var(--txm);cursor:pointer;line-height:1.4}
.hcheck.ticked{border-color:var(--g);background:var(--g3)}
.hcheck.ticked label{color:var(--g)}
/* GDPR block */
.gdpr-block{background:var(--s2);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;padding:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;font-size:11px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.8}
.gdpr-block p{margin-bottom:.5rem}.gdpr-block p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.gdpr-block strong{color:rgba(237,232,224,.8)}
/* consent */
.con-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:10px}
.con-row input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--g);margin-top:3px;flex-shrink:0;width:16px;height:16px;cursor:pointer}
.con-row label{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.7;cursor:pointer}
/* review */
.rv-hd{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--g);padding:8px 0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);margin-bottom:5px;margin-top:8px}
.rv-hd:first-child{margin-top:0}
.rv-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,.06)}
.rv-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.rv-k{font-size:11px;color:var(--txm);flex-shrink:0;margin-right:10px}
.rv-v{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;max-width:65%}
/* nav */
.nav{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:1.25rem;padding:0 1.25rem}
.btn-back{padding:11px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--txm);transition:all .2s}
.btn-back:hover{border-color:var(--hov);color:var(--hov);background:rgba(232,201,122,.05)}
.btn-next,.btn-sub{flex:1;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--g);border:none;color:#111;transition:background .2s}
.btn-next:hover,.btn-sub:hover{background:var(--g2)}
/* success */
.succ{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1.25rem}
.succ-mark{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(74,140,42,.15);border:1.5px solid var(--grn);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 1.25rem;font-size:26px}
.succ-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--g);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.succ-msg{font-size:13px;color:var(--txm);line-height:1.8}
.pdf-btn{margin-top:1.25rem;padding:12px 32px;border:1px solid var(--g);border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--g);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;display:inline-block}
.pdf-btn:hover{background:var(--g3);border-color:var(--hov);color:var(--hov)}
.pdf-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
/* ── PHONE PICKER ── */
.phone-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:8px}
.phone-row select{background:var(--inp);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:7px;padding:10px 8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--tx);outline:none;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s}
.phone-row select:focus{border-color:var(--g)}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TATTOOING ERKELENZ — Consultation Form v5

   panels use insertAdjacentHTML once (developer content only).
   Phone: ITU-T E.164  |  ZIP: per-country regex lookup.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
'use strict';

/* ── CONSTANTS ── */
var LS_KEY = 'tme_form_v5'; /* versioned — old poisoned keys ignored */

/* ── STATE ── */
var step = 1, svc = '', mode = 'online';
var D = {

var panelsInjected = {svc:false, place:false};

/* ── HELPERS (no innerHTML with user data) ── */
function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

/* Safe get value */
function gv(id){ var e=$(id); return e ? e.value.trim() : ''; }

/* Safe set text — never innerHTML */
function st(el, txt){ if(el) el.textContent = String(txt||''); }

/* Safe error/ok toggles */
function se(id, show){ var e=$(id); if(!e) return; if(show) e.classList.add('show'); else e.classList.remove('show'); }
function so(id, show){ var e=$(id); if(!e) return; if(show) e.classList.add('show'); else e.classList.remove('show'); }

function scrollUp(){ document.getElementById('tmf').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); }

/* ── POSTAL CODE PATTERNS (per-country, research-backed) ──
   Sources: GeoPostcodes, UPU, ISO 3166
   Strategy: country dropdown drives which regex applies.
   Universal fallback: 3–10 alphanumeric chars (covers most countries).
   ITU-T E.164: ^\+[1-9]\d{1,14}$ — max 15 digits, must start with +
*/
var ZIP_PATTERNS = {
  'DE': /^\d{5}$/,                                        /* Germany: 5 digits */
  'AT': /^\d{4}$/,                                        /* Austria: 4 digits */
  'CH': /^\d{4}$/,                                        /* Switzerland: 4 digits */
  'NL': /^\d{4}\s?[A-Z]{2}$/i,                           /* Netherlands: 1234 AB */
  'BE': /^\d{4}$/,                                        /* Belgium: 4 digits */
  'FR': /^\d{5}$/,                                        /* France: 5 digits */
  'GB': /^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]?\s?\d[A-Z]{2}$/i,         /* UK: SW1A 2AA */
  'US': /^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$/,                              /* USA: 12345 or 12345-6789 */
  'CA': /^[A-Z]\d[A-Z]\s?\d[A-Z]\d$/i,                  /* Canada: A1A 1A1 */
  'AU': /^\d{4}$/,                                        /* Australia: 4 digits */
  'TR': /^\d{5}$/,                                        /* Turkey: 5 digits */
  'PL': /^\d{2}-\d{3}$/,                                 /* Poland: 12-345 */
  'IT': /^\d{5}$/,                                        /* Italy: 5 digits */
  'ES': /^\d{5}$/,                                        /* Spain: 5 digits */
  'OTHER': /^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\s\-]{1,9}[A-Z0-9]$/i      /* Global fallback: 3–10 alnum */
};
var ZIP_PLACEHOLDER = {
  'DE':'41812','AT':'1010','CH':'8001','NL':'1234 AB','BE':'1000','FR':'75001',
  'GB':'SW1A 2AA','US':'90210','CA':'K1A 0A9','AU':'2000','TR':'34000',
  'PL':'00-001','IT':'00100','ES':'28001','OTHER':'Enter postal code'
};

function getZipPattern(){ return ZIP_PATTERNS[gv('p-country')] || ZIP_PATTERNS['OTHER']; }

function liveZip(el){
  var v = el.value.trim();
  if(!v){ inv('p-zip',false); se('e-zip',false); so('ok-zip',false); autosave(); return; }
  var ok = getZipPattern().test(v.toUpperCase());
  el.classList.toggle('inv', !ok);
  el.classList.toggle('ok', ok);
  se('e-zip', !ok);
  so('ok-zip', ok);
  autosave();
}

function onCountryChange(){
  var country = gv('p-country');
  var ph = $('p-zip');
  if(ph) ph.placeholder = ZIP_PLACEHOLDER[country] || 'Postal code';
  /* Re-validate if already filled */
  if(ph && ph.value.trim()) liveZip(ph);
  autosave();
}

/* ── PHONE: dial-code dropdown + local number field ──
   Combines selected dial code + local digits → E.164 for validation.
   Local number: 5–12 digits, may start with 0 (stripped when combining). */
function buildE164(){
  var dc  = $('p-dialcode'); // dial code select
  var ph  = $('p-phone');    // local number input
  if(!dc || !ph) return '';
  var code  = (dc.value||'').trim();
  var local = (ph.value||'').replace(/[\s\-\(\)]/g,'').replace(/^0+/,''); // strip leading zeros
  return code + local;
}
function validatePhone(){
  var e164 = buildE164();
  if(!e164) return false;
  /* E.164: +[1-9]\d{1,14}, total ≤16 chars including '+' */
  return /^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/.test(e164);
}
function livePhone(){
  var ph = $('p-phone');
  var v  = ph ? ph.value.trim() : '';
  if(!v){ ph.classList.remove('inv','ok'); se('e-phone',false); so('ok-phone',false); autosave(); return; }
  /* Validate: local must be 5-12 digits only */
  var localOk = /^\d[\d\s\-]{4,14}$/.test(v);
  ph.classList.toggle('inv', !localOk);
  ph.classList.toggle('ok', localOk);
  se('e-phone', !localOk);
  so('ok-phone', localOk);
  autosave();
}

/* ── AUTOSAVE — versioned, sanitised restore ── */
var saveTimer = null;
function autosave(){
  clearTimeout(saveTimer);
  saveTimer = setTimeout(function(){
    try{
      /* SECURITY: never serialise uploadBase64 — could be MB and break localStorage quota */
      var dSnap = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(D));
      delete dSnap.uploadBase64; // strip before save
      delete dSnap.uploadMime;
      var snap = {
        v:5, svc:svc, mode:mode, D:dSnap,
        fields:{
          name:gv('p-name'), dob:gv('p-dob'), email:gv('p-email'),
          dialcode: ($('p-dialcode')||{}).value||'+49',
          phone:gv('p-phone'), street:gv('p-street'), city:gv('p-city'),
          country:gv('p-country'), zip:gv('p-zip'), artist:gv('p-artist'),
          date:gv('p-date')
        }
      };
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(snap));
      var bar = $('save-bar'); if(bar) bar.style.display='flex';
    }catch(e){}
  }, 1200);
}

function restoreAutosave(){
  try{
    var raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
    if(!raw) return;
    var snap = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!snap || snap.v !== 5) return;
    var f = snap.fields || {};
    var fieldMap = {
      'p-name':'name','p-dob':'dob','p-email':'email','p-phone':'phone',
      'p-street':'street','p-city':'city','p-country':'country',
      'p-zip':'zip','p-artist':'artist','p-date':'date'
    };
    Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(function(id){
      var el = $(id); var val = f[fieldMap[id]];
      if(el && val) el.value = val;
    });
    /* Restore dial code separately */
    if(f.dialcode){ var dc=$('p-dialcode'); if(dc) dc.value=f.dialcode; }
    /* Restore D state */
    if(snap.D && typeof snap.D === 'object'){
      Object.keys(D).forEach(function(k){
        var v = snap.D[k];
        if(k==='uploadBase64'||k==='uploadMime') return;
        if(typeof D[k]==='string' && typeof v==='string') D[k]=v.substring(0,500);
        if(Array.isArray(D[k]) && Array.isArray(v)){
          D[k]=v.filter(function(x){return typeof x==='string'&&x.length<200;}).slice(0,50);
        }
      });
    }
    if(snap.svc) pickSvc(snap.svc, true);
    if(snap.mode) setMode(snap.mode, true);
    /* Restore calendar state — MUST happen after D restore and svc pick */
    if(f.dob){
      var dp=f.dob.split('-');
      if(dp.length===3) CAL.selDate['dob']={y:parseInt(dp[0],10),m:parseInt(dp[1],10)-1,d:parseInt(dp[2],10)};
      restoreCalDisplay('dob',f.dob);
    }
    if(f.date){
      var ap=f.date.split('-');
      if(ap.length===3) CAL.selDate['appt']={y:parseInt(ap[0],10),m:parseInt(ap[1],10)-1,d:parseInt(ap[2],10)};
      restoreCalDisplay('appt',f.date);
    }
    var bar = $('save-bar'); if(bar) bar.style.display='flex';
    livePhone();
    var zp = $('p-zip'); if(zp && zp.value) liveZip(zp);
    onCountryChange();
  }catch(e){}
}
function restoreCalDisplay(which, isoDate){
  /* Re-render cal trigger text from a saved ISO date string */
  if(!isoDate) return;
  var parts = isoDate.split('-');
  if(parts.length!==3) return;
  var y=parseInt(parts[0],10), m=parseInt(parts[1],10)-1, d=parseInt(parts[2],10);
  var months=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  var display = d+' '+months[m]+' '+y;
  var triggerId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-trigger' : 'appt-trigger';
  var displayId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-display' : 'appt-display';
  var trig=$(triggerId), disp=$(displayId);
  if(trig) trig.classList.add('ok');
  if(disp){ disp.textContent=display; disp.classList.remove('cal-placeholder'); }
}

function attachAutosave(){
  document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(function(el){
    if(!el._asSave){
      el._asSave = true;
      el.addEventListener('input', autosave);
      el.addEventListener('change', autosave);

}

/* ── VALIDATION ── */
function validate(s){
  var ok = true;
  if(s===1){
    if(!svc){ se('e-svc',true); ok=false; } else se('e-svc',false);
    var nm=gv('p-name'), em=gv('p-email'), db=gv('p-dob'),
        ph=gv('p-phone'), st2=gv('p-street'), ct=gv('p-city'),
        cn=gv('p-country'), zp=gv('p-zip');
    var emailOk = em && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(em);
    /* Phone: local field must have 5+ digits */
    var localDigits = ph.replace(/[\s\-\(\)]/g,'').replace(/^0+/,'');
    var phoneOk = localDigits.length >= 5;
    var zipOk   = zp && getZipPattern().test(zp.toUpperCase());
    inv('p-name',!nm);   se('e-name',!nm);
    inv('p-email',!emailOk); se('e-email',!emailOk);
    /* DOB uses hidden input — highlight trigger button */
    var dobTrig=$('dob-trigger');
    if(dobTrig){ dobTrig.classList.toggle('inv',!db); dobTrig.classList.toggle('ok',!!db); }
    se('e-dob',!db);
    var ph2=$('p-phone');
    if(ph2){ ph2.classList.toggle('inv',!phoneOk); ph2.classList.toggle('ok',phoneOk&&ph.length>0); }
    se('e-phone',!phoneOk); so('ok-phone',phoneOk&&ph.length>0);
    inv('p-street',!st2); se('e-street',!st2);
    inv('p-city',!ct);   se('e-city',!ct);
    inv('p-country',!cn); se('e-country',!cn);
    inv('p-zip',!zipOk); se('e-zip',!zipOk); so('ok-zip',zipOk);
    if(svc==='tattoo'){
      var ar=gv('p-artist');
      inv('p-artist',!ar); se('e-artist',!ar);
      if(!ar) ok=false;
    }
    if(!nm||!emailOk||!db||!phoneOk||!st2||!ct||!cn||!zipOk) ok=false;
  }
  if(s===2){
    if(svc==='tattoo'){
      if(!D.style){ se('e-style',true); ok=false; } else se('e-style',false);
      if(!D.color){ se('e-color',true); ok=false; } else se('e-color',false);
      if(!D.size){  se('e-size',true);  ok=false; } else se('e-size',false);
      /* p-desc is OPTIONAL — clear any stale error state if element exists */
      se('e-desc',false);
      var dc2=$('p-desc'); if(dc2) dc2.classList.remove('inv');
    }
    if(svc==='piercing'){ var np=D.ptypes.length===0; se('e-ptypes',np); if(np) ok=false; }
    if(svc==='pmu'){      var npm=D.pmutypes.length===0; se('e-pmutypes',npm); if(npm) ok=false; }
  }
  if(s===3){
    /* Placement is optional — no gate */
    /* Health: at least one checkbox ticked */
    var ticked = document.querySelectorAll('#health-checks input[type=checkbox]:checked');
    if(!ticked.length){ se('e-health',true); ok=false; } else se('e-health',false);
  }
  if(s===4){
    var dt=gv('p-date');
    var apptTrig=$('appt-trigger');
    if(apptTrig){ apptTrig.classList.toggle('inv',!dt); apptTrig.classList.toggle('ok',!!dt); }
    se('e-date',!dt); if(!dt) ok=false;
    if(!D.consult){ se('e-consult',true); ok=false; } else se('e-consult',false);
    if(!D.onSlot){  se('e-slot',true);    ok=false; } else se('e-slot',false);
    var c1=$('c1').checked, c3=$('c3').checked;
    if(!c1||!c3){ se('e-consent',true); ok=false; } else se('e-consent',false);
  }
  return ok;
}

/* ── ZONE TAP ── */

  var lbl = el.nextElementSibling;

    arr.splice(idx,1);
    el.classList.remove('sel-t','sel-p','sel-m');
    if(lbl&&lbl.tagName==='text') lbl.classList.remove('sel-t','sel-p','sel-m');
  }else{
    arr.push(label);
    el.classList.add(hlCls);
    if(lbl&&lbl.tagName==='text') lbl.classList.add(hlCls);
  }
  renderTags(type);
  autosave();
}
function removeTag(label, type){
  var arr = type==='t'?D.placements_t : type==='p'?D.placements_p : D.placements_m;
  var idx = arr.indexOf(label); if(idx>-1) arr.splice(idx,1);
  renderTags(type);
  autosave();
}

  var arr = type==='t'?D.placements_t : type==='p'?D.placements_p : D.placements_m;
  var c = $('ptags-'+type); if(!c) return;
  while(c.firstChild) c.removeChild(c.firstChild);
  if(!arr.length){
    var h=document.createElement('span'); h.className='place-note';
    h.textContent='No areas selected — describe placement in notes if preferred';
    c.appendChild(h); return;
  }
  arr.forEach(function(label){
    var span=document.createElement('span');
    span.className='ptag ptag-'+type;
    span.title='Click to remove';
    /* Safe: textContent — no innerHTML */
    span.textContent = label+' ×';
    span.addEventListener('click', function(){ removeTag(label,type); });
    c.appendChild(span);
  });
}

/* ── FILE UPLOAD — validates type + size, shows PDF indicator ── */
function handleFile(input){
  var f = input&&input.files&&input.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  var allowed=['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf'];
  if(allowed.indexOf(f.type)===-1){ alert('Please upload JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF only.'); input.value=''; return; }
  if(f.size>10*1024*1024){ alert('File must be under 10 MB.'); input.value=''; return; }

  /* Reset previous upload state */
  D.uploadName   = f.name;
  D.uploadBase64 = '';      /* BUG FIX: must store base64 so PDF can embed it */
  D.uploadMime   = f.type;

  $('upzone').classList.add('has');
  var un=$('up-name');
  un.style.display='block';
  st(un, '✓ '+f.name);

  if(f.type.startsWith('image/')){
    /* Show DOM preview AND capture base64 into D for PDF */
    $('pdf-pill').classList.remove('show');
    var r=new FileReader();
    r.onload=function(e){
      var b64=e.target.result;
      /* Save to state so makePDF() can call doc.addImage() */
      D.uploadBase64 = b64;
      var img=$('up-img');
      img.src=b64;
      img.style.display='block';
    };
    r.readAsDataURL(f);

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CUSTOM CALENDAR ENGINE
   Handles two calendars: 'dob' (past dates, DOB)
                          'appt' (future dates, appointment)
   Each has a trigger button, a popup, a hidden input.
   Mode: 'days' | 'months' | 'years'
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var CAL = {
  open: null,          /* which calendar is open: 'dob'|'appt'|null */
  mode: 'days',        /* days | months | years */
  viewYear: 2000,
  viewMonth: 0,        /* 0-11 */
  selDate: { dob:null, appt:null } /* {y,m,d} or null */
};
var MONTHS = ['January','February','March','April','May','June',
              'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
var DAYS   = ['Su','Mo','Tu','We','Th','Fr','Sa'];

function openCal(which){
  var other = which==='dob'?'appt':'dob';
  /* Close other if open */
  closeCal(other);
  /* If this one is already open, close it */
  if(CAL.open===which){ closeCal(which); return; }
  CAL.open = which;
  CAL.mode = 'days';
  /* Initialise view to selected date or sensible default */
  var now = new Date();
  if(CAL.selDate[which]){
    CAL.viewYear  = CAL.selDate[which].y;
    CAL.viewMonth = CAL.selDate[which].m;
  } else if(which==='dob'){
    CAL.viewYear  = now.getFullYear()-25;
    CAL.viewMonth = now.getMonth();
  } else {
    CAL.viewYear  = now.getFullYear();
    CAL.viewMonth = now.getMonth();
  }
  renderCal(which);
  var popup=$('cal-popup-'+which);
  if(popup) popup.classList.remove('hidden');
}
function closeCal(which){
  var popup=$('cal-popup-'+which);
  if(popup) popup.classList.add('hidden');
  if(CAL.open===which) CAL.open=null;
}
function renderCal(which){
  var popup=$('cal-popup-'+which);
  if(!popup) return;
  /* Clear */
  while(popup.firstChild) popup.removeChild(popup.firstChild);
  if(CAL.mode==='days')   renderCalDays(popup, which);
  if(CAL.mode==='months') renderCalMonths(popup, which);
  if(CAL.mode==='years')  renderCalYears(popup, which);
}

function renderCalDays(popup, which){
  var now  = new Date();
  var isDob = which==='dob';
  var head = document.createElement('div'); head.className='cal-head';
  /* Prev arrow */
  var prev = document.createElement('button'); prev.type='button';
  prev.className='cal-nav'; prev.textContent='‹';
  prev.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewMonth--; if(CAL.viewMonth<0){CAL.viewMonth=11;CAL.viewYear--;} renderCal(which); });
  /* Title — click to go to month picker */
  var title = document.createElement('div'); title.className='cal-head-title';
  title.textContent = MONTHS[CAL.viewMonth]+' '+CAL.viewYear;
  title.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.mode='months'; renderCal(which); });
  /* Next arrow */
  var next = document.createElement('button'); next.type='button';
  next.className='cal-nav'; next.textContent='›';
  next.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewMonth++; if(CAL.viewMonth>11){CAL.viewMonth=0;CAL.viewYear++;} renderCal(which); });
  head.appendChild(prev); head.appendChild(title); head.appendChild(next);
  /* DOW row */
  var dow = document.createElement('div'); dow.className='cal-dow';
  DAYS.forEach(function(d){ var s=document.createElement('span'); s.textContent=d; dow.appendChild(s); });
  /* Days grid */
  var grid = document.createElement('div'); grid.className='cal-days';
  var first = new Date(CAL.viewYear, CAL.viewMonth, 1).getDay(); // 0=Sun
  var daysInMonth = new Date(CAL.viewYear, CAL.viewMonth+1, 0).getDate();
  /* Empty cells before first day */
  for(var i=0;i<first;i++){
    var empty=document.createElement('div'); empty.className='cal-day cal-empty'; grid.appendChild(empty);
  }
  for(var d=1;d<=daysInMonth;d++){
    (function(day){
      var cell=document.createElement('div'); cell.className='cal-day';
      cell.textContent=day;
      var thisDate = new Date(CAL.viewYear, CAL.viewMonth, day);
      /* Today marker */
      if(thisDate.toDateString()===now.toDateString()) cell.classList.add('cal-today');
      /* Disable future dates for DOB */
      if(isDob && thisDate > now) cell.classList.add('cal-disabled');
      /* Disable past dates for appointment */
      if(!isDob){
        var today = new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate());
        if(thisDate < today) cell.classList.add('cal-disabled');
      }
      /* Selected */
      var sel=CAL.selDate[which];
      if(sel && sel.y===CAL.viewYear && sel.m===CAL.viewMonth && sel.d===day) cell.classList.add('cal-sel');
      if(!cell.classList.contains('cal-disabled')){
        cell.addEventListener('click',function(e){
          e.stopPropagation();
          CAL.selDate[which]={y:CAL.viewYear, m:CAL.viewMonth, d:day};
          selectCalDate(which);
        });
      }
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    })(d);
  }
  /* Footer */
  var foot = document.createElement('div'); foot.className='cal-footer';
  var todayBtn = document.createElement('button'); todayBtn.type='button';
  todayBtn.className='cal-today-btn';
  todayBtn.textContent = isDob ? 'Jump to today' : 'Today';
  todayBtn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    CAL.viewYear=now.getFullYear(); CAL.viewMonth=now.getMonth();
    CAL.mode='days'; renderCal(which);
  });
  var clearBtn = document.createElement('button'); clearBtn.type='button';
  clearBtn.className='cal-clear-btn'; clearBtn.textContent='Clear';
  clearBtn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.stopPropagation(); clearCalDate(which);
  });
  foot.appendChild(todayBtn); foot.appendChild(clearBtn);
  popup.appendChild(head); popup.appendChild(dow); popup.appendChild(grid); popup.appendChild(foot);
}

function renderCalMonths(popup, which){
  var head = document.createElement('div'); head.className='cal-head';
  var prev = document.createElement('button'); prev.type='button'; prev.className='cal-nav'; prev.textContent='‹';
  prev.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewYear--; renderCal(which); });
  var title = document.createElement('div'); title.className='cal-head-title';
  title.textContent=String(CAL.viewYear);
  title.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.mode='years'; renderCal(which); });
  var next = document.createElement('button'); next.type='button'; next.className='cal-nav'; next.textContent='›';
  next.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewYear++; renderCal(which); });
  head.appendChild(prev); head.appendChild(title); head.appendChild(next);
  var grid = document.createElement('div'); grid.className='cal-ym-grid';
  MONTHS.forEach(function(mName,mi){
    (function(idx){
      var item=document.createElement('div'); item.className='cal-ym-item';
      item.textContent=mName.substring(0,3);
      var sel=CAL.selDate[which];
      if(sel && sel.m===idx && sel.y===CAL.viewYear) item.classList.add('sel');
      item.addEventListener('click',function(e){
        e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewMonth=idx; CAL.mode='days'; renderCal(which);
      });
      grid.appendChild(item);
    })(mi);
  });
  popup.appendChild(head); popup.appendChild(grid);
}

function renderCalYears(popup, which){
  var base = Math.floor(CAL.viewYear/10)*10;
  var head = document.createElement('div'); head.className='cal-head';
  var prev=document.createElement('button'); prev.type='button'; prev.className='cal-nav'; prev.textContent='‹';
  prev.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewYear-=10; renderCal(which); });
  var title=document.createElement('div'); title.className='cal-head-title';
  title.textContent=base+' – '+(base+9);
  var next=document.createElement('button'); next.type='button'; next.className='cal-nav'; next.textContent='›';
  next.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewYear+=10; renderCal(which); });
  head.appendChild(prev); head.appendChild(title); head.appendChild(next);
  var grid=document.createElement('div'); grid.className='cal-ym-grid';
  for(var y=base;y<base+10;y++){
    (function(yr){
      var item=document.createElement('div'); item.className='cal-ym-item';
      item.textContent=yr;
      var sel=CAL.selDate[which];
      if(sel && sel.y===yr) item.classList.add('sel');
      item.addEventListener('click',function(e){
        e.stopPropagation(); CAL.viewYear=yr; CAL.mode='months'; renderCal(which);
      });
      grid.appendChild(item);
    })(y);
  }
  popup.appendChild(head); popup.appendChild(grid);
}

function selectCalDate(which){
  var sel=CAL.selDate[which];
  if(!sel) return;
  /* ISO string for hidden input */
  var mm=String(sel.m+1).padStart(2,'0'), dd=String(sel.d).padStart(2,'0');
  var iso=sel.y+'-'+mm+'-'+dd;
  /* Display string for trigger button */
  var display=sel.d+' '+MONTHS[sel.m]+' '+sel.y;
  var hiddenId  = which==='dob' ? 'p-dob'       : 'p-date';
  var triggerId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-trigger'  : 'appt-trigger';
  var displayId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-display'  : 'appt-display';
  var hidden=$(hiddenId), trig=$(triggerId), disp=$(displayId);
  if(hidden) hidden.value=iso;
  if(trig){ trig.classList.remove('inv'); trig.classList.add('ok'); }
  if(disp){ disp.textContent=display; disp.classList.remove('cal-placeholder'); }
  closeCal(which);
  autosave();
}
function clearCalDate(which){
  CAL.selDate[which]=null;
  var hiddenId  = which==='dob' ? 'p-dob'      : 'p-date';
  var triggerId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-trigger' : 'appt-trigger';
  var displayId = which==='dob' ? 'dob-display' : 'appt-display';
  var hidden=$(hiddenId), trig=$(triggerId), disp=$(displayId);
  if(hidden) hidden.value='';
  if(trig){ trig.classList.remove('ok','inv'); }
  if(disp){ disp.textContent=which==='dob'?'Select date of birth':'Select preferred date'; disp.classList.add('cal-placeholder'); }
  renderCal(which);
  autosave();
}
/* Close calendar when clicking outside */
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  if(!CAL.open) return;
  var popupId='cal-popup-'+CAL.open;
  var popup=$(popupId);
  var triggerId=(CAL.open==='dob'?'dob-trigger':'appt-trigger');
  var trigger=$(triggerId);
  if(popup&&!popup.contains(e.target)&&trigger&&!trigger.contains(e.target)){
    closeCal(CAL.open);
  }
});
